The unsurpassed combination of glacier, mountain and lake makes Zell am See-Kaprun one of the most sought-after holiday destinations in the Alps. At the foot of the 3,203-metre-high Kitzsteinhorn and on the edge of the Hohe Tauern National Park, the region provides amazingly beautiful hiking, leisure and sports opportunities as well as great excursion destinations in a magnificent natural landscape. 
In addition, the region is an insider's tip for its delightful alpine cuisine with numerous award-winning restaurants.
